design.frame: V61 right-handed, x transverse y approach, z absolute

recipe.random: Python random.Random; iterate segments in declared order, lower then upper course; n=ceil(length/.66), base=linspace(a,b,n+1). Lower internal cuts uniform(-.055,.055) offsets to base, upper internal cuts midpoints of base intervals plus uniform(-.04,.04), endpoints unchanged. Each internal cut uses four independent uniform(-.035,.035) shifts in longitudinal coordinate at transverse linspace(t0,t1,4), endpoints of band use zero offsets; adjacent polygons use same path reversed. Iterate all cuts before constructing stones.
recipe.lower: z bottom=min(exact TIN footprint min-.12, joint-.14); upper surface=joint
recipe.upper: joint to cap underside, exact shared polygon joints, no through-gap
recipe.core: pad minus wall union, clip against every exact source TIN triangle, lower=ground-.12, upper=28.29
recipe.ramp: V61 exact 4 planar ramp triangles, clip with source TIN, lower=ground-.12 upper=original ramp plane; top unchanged
recipe.surface: Provisional continuous .05m walk cap above core and wall, no change to collision surface. Stone face recess .006m and bevel <=.012m only on exposed faces; native cutter not validated. No structural load calculation.

design.limitations: Local plan and support design only. 10 upper end stones contact single underlying stone; corner bands are butt joints, not fully bonded. Continuous cap requires finished surface and collision review. V60 gate silhouette, material wear/ivy and actual cuts still partial. No native new meshes or load physics.
